title: Digestive System
ques: When you eat an apple, your body breaks it down to get energy. What is the name of the organ in your body where food is mixed with special juices to break it down into a liquid?
explanation: This focuses on identifying a major organ within the digestive system and its primary function.

title: Respiratory System
ques: What happens in your lungs when you take a deep breath in, and what happens when you breathe out?

answer.content: When you breathe in, your lungs fill up with air and take in **Oxygen**, which your body needs. When you breathe out, your lungs push out **Carbon Dioxide**, which is a waste gas your body needs to get rid of.

explanation: This details the gas exchange process in the respiratory system.

title: Circulatory System Basics
ques: Which organ acts like a pump to push blood all around your body, and what does the blood carry to your muscles?

answer.content: The **Heart** acts like a pump. The blood carries **oxygen** and **nutrients** (from food) to your muscles and all other parts of your body.

explanation: This links the circulatory system with the respiratory and digestive systems.
